prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: knee injury. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1390; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Received first notice of loss from insured driver. Vehicle was struck while insured was turning left at an intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered on a green light. Photos requested and police report number recorded.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant's attorney's office. Attorney confirmed representation and asked that all communication go through their office. Claimant reports pain in right knee following the collision. Medical authorization forms requested.

Entry 3: Reviewed scene diagram and two witness statements. Both witnesses describe the insured's vehicle beginning the left turn while the opposing vehicle approached from the opposite direction. Liability appears disputed. Referred file for further review of signal timing data.

Entry 4: Received medical records from claimant's treating orthopedic provider. Records document a torn meniscus in the right knee and a recommendation for arthroscopic evaluation. Treatment is ongoing. Forwarded records to the medical review unit.

Entry 5: Attorney's office submitted a demand letter for bodily injury coverage and property damage. Demand is under review. Scheduled a call with defense counsel to discuss liability position and next steps for negotiation. File remains open pending medical review.
